skin: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game material source, square 2048 x 2048 pixels. Paint a seamless orthographic flat albedo texture of dry horny skin on the sides and padded soles of a coastal pteranodon's wading-bird toes and small wing fingers. Entire square filled edge to edge with extremely fine rounded irregular pebbled scales. This square represents 200 x 200 mm: each pebble is only 0.5 to 1.5 mm, so roughly 200 individual pebbles across the width. Natural varied spacing, sizes and outlines, soft padded grain, no geometric grid, no large plates. Light neutral monochrome grey, average sRGB 188, with restrained natural lighter pebble crowns and finely darker pigment gaps. Material value drawing should remain clear unlit. Even omnidirectional diffuse illumination, NO directional shading, NO specular highlights, NO large gradient, NO vignetting. Dry matte to satin, NOT rocks, NOT crocodile scales, NOT cracks. Keep the fine biological drawing detailed and elegant. No text, no objects, no border. Seamlessly tile both axes.
scutes: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game material source, square 2048 x 2048 pixels. Seamless flat orthographic albedo of avian horny transverse toe scutes on a pteranodon's slender grasping feet. Tile represents 200 x 200 mm. Toe length runs LEFT TO RIGHT, so each fine transverse scute runs TOP TO BOTTOM. Each successive scute along x only 3 to 6 mm long, about 45 irregular overlapping cross bands across the image. Arrange many varied longitudinal tracts of scutes: short vertical oblong scute plates 4-12 mm tall ending into very fine rounded pebbles of 0.5-1.5 mm. Several staggered tracts from top to bottom, natural irregular subdivision and gentle wavering seams, NOT brick masonry, NOT a regular rectangular grid. Scutes subtly overlap with fine keratin lips and delicate fine grain. All skin light neutral monochrome grey average sRGB 188. Carry the subtle material drawing in albedo: slightly lighter scutes and darker hairline pigment joints. Even unlit diffuse look, NO directional light, NO highlights, NO cast shadows, NO broad gradient, NO vignette. Fine wading bird foot skin, not crocodile armor. Seamless on both axes, no foot silhouette, no text, no border.
claw: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: flat game texture panel, square 2048 x 2048 pixels representing 60 x 60 mm. A single laterally flattened pteranodon claw side UV panel laid flat, root at left and tip at right, strongly curving downward. Arc length about 45 mm; broad root centered at (0.18,0.36), gently arched upper side running across to (0.7,0.45), sharply hooked downturned tip at (0.8,0.73). The claw's full panel occupies most of central square with ample margin of THE SAME near-black brown-grey horn extended continuously around it, NOT an isolated object or cutout. Fine keratin growth striations ALONG the curved root-to-tip flow, tiny natural irregularities, a few small nicks, a slightly paler and smoother worn point. Inherent dark brown-grey horn with muted warm grey wear. Flat orthographic unlit albedo, no form shading or cast shadow, NO painted highlight or reflection: polish will be supplied by a roughness map. Maintain fine attractive keratin texture and clear curved grain direction. Opaque texture everywhere, NO white background, no text, no frame.
eye: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: flat game albedo texture panel 2048 x 2048, 50 x 50 mm. One pteranodon eye centered EXACTLY at middle, visible circular amber iris diameter 18 mm (36 percent of image width). Round black pupil, diameter 7 mm, centered. Dark amber iris with elaborate very fine radial organic fibers and crypts, darker outer limbal rim, rich restrained ochre/umber, NOT bright yellow. Thin bare finely wrinkled skin lid ring surrounding eye, a slight brow above. Outside the eye to the entire square edge is fine grey reptile/bird eyelid skin with delicate irregular tiny pebbles and fine wrinkles, no feathers. This surrounding skin and exterior eyelid must be LIGHT NEUTRAL GREY sRGB 188 because the engine dyes it charcoal. Only eye, inner wet lid edge remain naturally colored dark amber and dark grey. A texture artist's flat unlit orthographic albedo, absolutely NO corneal highlight, NO white reflection dot, NO specular, NO shadow from brow, NO directional light, NO vignetting. Fine material pigment drawing in base. No labels or text or frame.
mouth: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game albedo texture, square 2048 x 2048 pixels represents 200 x 200 mm. Seamless flat orthographic texture of a toothless coastal pteranodon's inner mouth lining. Pale pinkish-grey mucosal lining, smooth with very faint irregular longitudinal ridges running horizontally LEFT TO RIGHT, roughly 2 to 6 mm apart, gradual fine forks and soft uneven lengths. Very restrained delicate pigment variation in muted rosy grey, smooth delicate tissue with minute microtexture, NOT exposed flesh, NOT blood vessels, NOT heavy folds or guts. Moistness will be supplied via roughness: no painted gloss, no highlights, no directional shading, no cast shadows, no broad gradient or vignette. Even material value across the square and seamless in both axes. No objects, no teeth, no text, no borders.
